jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer AI
jobs.description:
Based in Portugal, Wire IT is your specialized IT consulting partner with 18 years of experience driven by an experienced and senior team that helps clients make the right decisions in a fast-moving market.
Wire IT's ambition is to grow while keeping true to its nature: agile, people-centered, and fun. As we like to say: It's not only what we do, it's how we manage that truly make the difference..
If you're looking for more than just a job - if you're looking for a place where you can truly make a difference - you might be the next person to join WIRE IT.

Role:
Senior .NET AI Developer
Location:
Hybrid, Porto, Portugal

Required Skills:
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in C# and .NET/.NET Core.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Generative AI, or Data Science.
Proficiency in Python and AI frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch alongside .NET.
Hands-on experience with NLP tools such as Hugging Face and LLM frameworks such as GPT and Transformers.
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure/AWS, microservices, and deploying custom models.
Experience with containerization using Docker and Kubernetes and DevOps/CI/CD pipelines.
Solid grasp of trusted AI practices, API security, and data privacy.
Excellent problem-solving skills, Agile/Scrum proficiency, and fluent English.
Experience designing, building and maintaining efficient C#/.NET code alongside production-ready ML pipelines.
Ability to translate business requirements into functional applications and AI/ML solutions, particularly NLP and LLMs.
Experience fine-tuning, deploying and optimizing pre-trained models for specific product use cases.

We offer:
­No-term full-time contract;
Health Insurance;
22 days of paid vacation;
4 extra days annually (Carnival, Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve, Birthday);
Meal Allowance on card (Coverflex);
Referral Bonus;
Special discounts and flex options;
Training annual budget;
A great team-oriented culture;
Chance to become a part of a dynamically growing international company;
Challenging projects giving the unique opportunity to grow and learn.

Following the EU General Data Protection Regulation No. 2016/679, we inform you that by responding to this announcement, you consent to the use of your data by Wire IT, for as long as necessary. In case of doubt or request for elimination of your personal data, please send an email to info@wireit.pt

jobs.title: .NET/Full-stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Join the HELMES team as a Mid Full-Stack Engineer
and make a real impact!

You'll be contributing to a crucial project – the Tele2 self-care portal, used by hundreds of thousands across Estonia. We value communicative and growth-oriented individuals who thrive in an open, informal, and responsible environment and are driven to expand their knowledge.

If you're looking to join a community of talented professionals and grow with a company that invests in your success, we encourage you to apply!

Challenges you'll tackle:

Develop reusable, testable, and efficient code
Collaborate with the Solution Architect to ensure architectural alignment in your code
Work with the Product Owner to define and agree on technical solutions.
Be involved in the full product lifecycle: building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining our services, while also exploring new technologies
Participate in root cause analysis and help resolve support issues
Keep development projects on track by following Agile practices and actively participating in the team

Skills for success:

Hands-on experience with .NET and .NET Core;
Experience with Front-End development – React is a plus, but other frameworks work too;
Solid understanding of databases and SQL;
Good English skills – written and spoken
Willingness to grow and learn;
Comfortable working as part of a team and communicating openly.

Benefits

Competitive Compensation & Growth Opportunities

Dedicated training budget for conferences, online courses, and books to support continuous learning
Professional development through workshops, coaching sessions, and tech events

Work-Life Balance & Flexibility

Flexible working hours to suit your schedule
Unlimited work-from-home option for greater autonomy
Helmes Wellness Package - 300€ for a modern and flexible approach to health and well-being benefits

Community & Team Connection

Employee referral program with rewards up to 2000€ net
Clients & External Ambassadors with rewards up to 5000€ net
Social events, including Summer/Winter parties and a Dev Day celebration
Team-building activities and live meet-ups with clients for enhanced collaboration

For this position, we offer 3 300 € - 4 500 €/month gross salary.

The final offer will depend on your experience and competencies.
